name: Sign
description: Place your signature on a PDF, optionally add a Content Credential and lock the result.

inputs.label: PDF
inputs.help: The PDF stays on this device.

inputs.label: Signature
inputs.help: Use a transparent PNG/JPEG, upload an image, or paste the output link from the Signature tool.

inputs.label: Drawn signature
inputs.help: Signature strokes drawn directly in this tool.

inputs.label: Position in PDF points
inputs.help: Drag the signature on the page preview or enter exact PDF-point coordinates.

inputs.label: Add a Content Credential
inputs.help: Names the signer from the profile when Use my details is on. This is optional provenance, not a regulated e-signature service.

inputs.label: Lock with an open password
inputs.help: The password is requested only when downloading and is never stored in tool state. Locking and Content Credentials cannot be combined because encryption would invalidate the credential.
